Done. Here's where things landed:

## Applied — $23,325.50 (3 of 4 receipts)

| Entry | Customer | Amount | Applied to |
|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00312 | Beacon Health | $9,600.00 | INV-1041 ($4,350) + INV-1047 ($5,250) |
| JE-00313 | Corvid Retail | $8,450.00 | INV-1044 |
| JE-00314 | Dunmore Foods | $5,275.50 | INV-1049 |

Each is `Dr 2950 Unapplied Cash / Cr 1100 AR`, with the remittance advice **and** the underlying invoice attached as support. All three are under the $10k posting limit, so no approval routing was needed.

Before posting, I didn't just take the remittances at face value — for each one I confirmed the cited invoice actually existed, agreed the amount exactly, and checked the ledger to confirm the invoice was still genuinely open. Worth noting: all three of these customers also had **separate** subscription invoices that were already paid on their own (e.g. Beacon's INV-2102/2107/2112), so there was real double-application risk here. The remittances all pointed at the one-off services/add-on invoices in the INV-10xx series, not the INV-21xx subscriptions.

## Left in Unapplied Cash — $3,000.00 (flagged EXC-001)

**Evergreen Bank, 3/23, $3,000** (JE-00291). I left this alone:
- No remittance advice exists for it.
- Evergreen has **zero open AR** — all three 2026 invoices ($6,200 each) were invoiced and paid in full.
- $3,000 doesn't match any invoice or combination, and it arrived just three days *after* the March invoice was already settled.

Most likely an overpayment, an advance on a future period, or a misdirected deposit. Rather than force it somewhere, it stays in 2950 per policy 8.

**Two things for your attention:** (1) Someone in AR should contact Evergreen — if it's an overpayment it probably belongs in a customer credit/refund liability rather than sitting in Unapplied Cash past Q1. (2) That $3,000 is real cash in account 1000, so it'll need to be handled as a reconciling item in the still-open US bank rec.

I also attached the remittance advices to the three original bank-feed deposit entries, which had posted with no support at all (policy 2). UK and DE both had nil balances in 2950 — nothing to do there. US Unapplied Cash is now $3,000 credit, down from $26,325.50. I didn't mark any checklist items complete, since cash application sits underneath the still-open bank rec / AR items rather than being its own line.
